NewsArticle.Title: Beware of Portal
NewsArticle.Content:
Do not stand beside a portal.
Portals will suck in a character that stands directly beside it for 30 seconds. This prevents a harasser from blocking a portal.
In the past, some menaces spawned by a gross region of cyberspace had infiltrated Temuair and stood in front of a portal for no other purpose than to keep another character from passing.
Guards and others were given the Throw ability, which throws the harasser through the portal. However, sometimes a guard is not available, or the refuse that is thrown through returns. Now, the refuse is thrown away after 30 seconds.
